map.便隐血(OB)判读器，化学法与免疫法结果判读并评估消化道出血风险，辅助筛查与随访: The occult blood (OB) reader interprets both chemical and immunoassay results and assesses gastrointestinal bleeding risk, supporting screening and follow-up.

map.：免疫法阳性提示肠道出血可能，工具提示尽早结肠镜排查息肉/肿瘤；但痔疮、炎症也可: : a positive immunoassay suggests possible intestinal bleeding, and the tool advises an early colonoscopy to check for polyps or tumors; hemorrhoids and inflammation can also be positive, so endoscopy is needed to confirm.
map.阳性就是肠癌吗？: Does a Positive Result Mean Colon Cancer?
map.不是，息肉、炎症、痔疮均可阳性；但阳性应重视并做结肠镜。: No — polyps, inflammation, and hemorrhoids can all be positive; but a positive result deserves attention and a colonoscopy.
map.阴性能排除吗？: Can a Negative Result Rule It Out?
map.不能百分百，间期癌与漏检可能；按筛查周期复测。: Not a hundred percent — interval cancers and missed lesions are possible; retest on the screening schedule.
map.不能，潜血是筛查，确诊靠结肠镜与病理。: No — occult blood is a screening step; confirmation requires colonoscopy and pathology.
